import sys
input = sys.stdin.read().split()
index = 0
T = int(input[index])
results = []
for _ in range(T):
    index += 1
    n = int(input[index])
    swag_traits = []
    for _ in range(n):
        index += 1
        ki = int(input[index])
        trait = list(map(int, input[index + 1:index + 1 + ki]))
        swag_traits.append(trait)
        index += ki
    rk_swag = 0
    rg_swag = 0
    while swag_traits:
        max_diff = float('-inf')
        best_trait_rk = None
        for i, trait in enumerate(swag_traits):
            if len(trait) > 1:
                diff = trait[0] - trait[-1]
                if diff > max_diff:
                    max_diff = diff
                    best_trait_rk = i
            elif len(trait) == 1:
                if trait[0] > max_diff:
                    max_diff = trait[0]
                    best_trait_rk = i
        if best_trait_rk is not None:
            rk_swag += swag_traits[best_trait_rk].pop(0)
            if not swag_traits[best_trait_rk]:
                swag_traits.pop(best_trait_rk)
        min_diff = float('inf')
        best_trait_rg = None
        for i, trait in enumerate(swag_traits):
            diff = trait[-1] - trait[0]
            if diff < min_diff:
                min_diff = diff
                best_trait_rg = i
        if best_trait_rg is not None:
            rg_swag += swag_traits[best_trait_rg].pop()
            if not swag_traits[best_trait_rg]:
                swag_traits.pop(best_trait_rg)
    results.append(f"{rk_swag} {rg_swag}")
print("\n".join(results))
